settings.text_style_prompt: Mature industrial switchback levitating Arc Relay bot. High-roughness matte powder-coated ceramic and painted metal: one pale-greige lobe and one soft moss-gray lobe, warm-nickel protected coils. Soft diffuse finish, fine dry surface grain, restrained wear, metal only on mechanisms. Medium-light values readable in a dark arena; charcoal only in narrow recesses. Preserve every material boundary. No glossy plastic, clearcoat, lacquer, wet shine, broad highlights, saturated or neon color, black body, pure white, teal, cyan, orange, glow, text, decals, eyes, guns, or legs.
